# Oppvera Watch

> Educational fork of OneGlanse for learning GEO and AI visibility.

Oppvera Watch monitors how your brand appears inside real AI products: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overview. It captures what users actually see — inline citations, ranked recommendations, brand framing, and competitor co-mentions — using real browser automation, not model APIs.

## Key points

- **UI-first, not API-based.** Most GEO tools query the model API. Oppvera Watch opens the actual ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and AI Overview interfaces the same way a user would and captures the rendered response.
- **Educational fork.** Based on OneGlanse with marketing-friendly docs, local install guides, and no upstream telemetry.
- **Your own provider accounts.** Authenticates to AI providers using your own existing logins. No shared credentials.
- **Self-hosted.** All data stays on your machine or VPS.
